name: Diffusion Engineers Ltd
title: Diffusion Engineers Ltd - 544264 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Capacity-constrained niche consumables and wear-parts maker: standalone wear plates, wear parts and heavy engineering at 85-90% utilisation, new capacity from Q1 FY27 supports guided >20% growth, with margins guided up 80-100bp and debtor days (98) the watch item.

utilisation.quote: we are already at a capacity utilization of 85% percent in our, you know, manufacturing of wear plates, heavy engineering and wear parts

capex.quote: we don't expect any additional capex, not just for up to INR650 crores, but even up to higher

triggers.label: Wear plates/heavy eng utilisation 85-90%
triggers.quote: as we speak, close to 85%-90% utilization. So, of course, as soon as these new shop floors get ready

triggers.label: Debtor days 98 in FY26
triggers.quote: as per as the debtor days are right now, 98 days for FY26

triggers.label: Fixed-price contracts, margin hit on RM spikes
triggers.quote: Of course, if the prices go up, we take a margin hit in these contracts.

guidance.quote: We expect revenue to grow by more than 20%, supported by capacity additions and strong order inflows

guidance.value: INR650 crores+ in 2-3 years at 15-16% EBITDA margin
guidance.quote: Our long-term inspiration remains to build a INR650 crores plus revenue platform with sustainable EBITDA margins in the range of 15% to 16%.
our indication would be anywhere between 80 to 90 days
we expect the international revenue to go up to 15% in the next, in this year and the next year

prior_guidance_check.quote: you had guided for around 20% growth for the current year

red_flags.label: Debtor days elevated at 98 (FY26)
red_flags.quote: as per as the debtor days are right now, 98 days for FY26

red_flags.label: Q4-heavy revenue, Q4 sale ~INR140 crore vs preceding quarter
red_flags.quote: in Q4, we have done a sale of close to 140 crores in comparison to the preceding quarter

evasions.quote: we can connect offline if needed because this is confidential data and it's sensitive to our business

evasions.topic: Governance question answered with compliance boilerplate
evasions.quote: So, we are very prompt in our corporate governance and compliance practices.
